record.original_question: Can one solve d-bar with Hölder estimates on any real analytic bounded pseudoconvex domain in C^n ? 6.3

evidence.quote: Problem 6.2.1 Can one solve ∂¯ with Hölder estimates on any real analytic bounded pseudoconvex domain in Cn ? 6.3 Lp Estimates for ∂¯

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ be a bounded pseudoconvex domain whose boundary $\partial \Omega$ is real analytic. The Cauchy–Riemann operator $\bar\partial$ acts on $(p,q)$-forms with $1 \le q \le n$. One says that $\bar\partial$ can be solved with Hölder estimates on $\Omega$ if there exist a constant $\alpha \in (0,1)$ and, for every $\bar\partial$-closed bounded $(p,q)$-form $f$ on $\Omega$ with $L^\infty$ coefficients, a $(p,q-1)$-form $u$ on $\Omega$ such that
$$\bar\partial u = f \quad \text{on } \Omega, \qquad \|u\|_{\Lambda^\alpha(\overline{\Omega})} \le C\,\|f\|_{L^\infty(\Omega)},$$
where $C$ depends only on $\Omega$ (and on $p,q$), and $\Lambda^\alpha(\overline{\Omega})$ denotes the standard Hölder space of exponent $\alpha$.

Question: For every $n \ge 2$ and every bounded pseudoconvex domain $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ with real analytic boundary, can the $\bar\partial$ equation be solved with Hölder estimates in the sense above?
artifact.status_search_result: Partial progress exists: in $\mathbb{C}^2$ and (more recently) in $\mathbb{C}^3$, sup-norm and Hölder-type estimates for $\bar\partial$ have been established for bounded pseudoconvex domains with real-analytic boundary or finite type. The general case for arbitrary $n \ge 4$ on real analytic bounded pseudoconvex domains does not appear to be settled in the literature surveyed.

status_evidence.snippet: Sup-norm/Hölder estimates established for bounded pseudoconvex domains with real-analytic boundary in ℂ³.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is resolved affirmatively in dimension 3 for real-analytic boundary.

status_evidence.title: Sobolev and Hölder estimates for the ∂̄ equation on pseudoconvex domains of finite type in ℂ²
status_evidence.snippet: Hölder estimates for ∂̄ on finite-type pseudoconvex domains in ℂ².
status_evidence.claim: Dimension 2 case is well-understood; higher-dimensional general case remains active.
